historical_snapshot_rule: Verify completion file paths against the indicated Git commit, not a later evolving working tree. The A2 README snapshot remains at its commit; the current README includes completed geometry results.
historical_status_fields: local/uncommitted fields in receipts and registry describe execution time. These publication commit identities supersede them for publication status, without rewriting original receipts.
local_only_files: Dataset, checkpoint, reference arrays, calibration arrays and individual maps remain ignored; published summary tables/charts and notebooks are inspectable without them.
